about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for adq (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Appendix D is placed under Appendix C in the heading path, but they are separate appendices.
findings.evidence: tree: "Appendix C: Documents referred to > Appendix D: Standards referred to > Loss Prevention Certification Board"

findings.problem: The intro text is mixed with words that are not printed on this page, about requirement Q1 and the 1 October 2015 start date.
findings.evidence: source: "The following documents have been published to give guidance on how to meet the Building Regulations." / tree: "This approved document supports requirement Q1 ... It takes effect on 1 October 2015"

findings.problem: Approved Document L2B is not kept as a heading; its title is merged into the L2A text together with an unprinted footnote about Wales.
findings.evidence: tree: "It also applies to building work carried out on excepted energy Approved Document L2B buildings in Wales"

findings.problem: The intro sentence is broken up and its pieces are scattered among the unprinted text.
findings.evidence: source: "You can find the date of the edition approved by the Secretary of State at www.gov.uk." / tree: "You can find the date of the edition approved 1 October 2015, or work subject to"

findings.problem: The chapter title adds words that are not printed on the page.
findings.evidence: source: "List of approved documents" / tree: "The 2015 Edition List of approved documents"

findings.problem: The tree has back-cover headings and text that are not printed on this imprint page.
findings.evidence: tree: "The Building Regulations 2010", "Q", "APPROVED DOCUMENT", "2015 edition – for use in England*", "Q1 Unauthorised access"

findings.problem: The Crown copyright notice is read as a table with an invented column heading.
